topic: Replay validation runs without a deadline (accepted low)
detail: From the SP-047 security audit (0 critical/high; the one medium was fixed). ReplaySpaces validates the revision or policy it replays under (InGitTree checks and symlink resolution of up to 512 roots, terms and gh_config_dir paths) with no deadline. A draft an agent session saved can be named by --policy <rev>, so a root on an automount or network path could stall that RPC or make the Mac contact a host. Only the operator can call it, and diff and apply validate drafts the same way. Option: validate under the request deadline in a goroutine abandoned on cancellation, and say in the reply when the named revision is an agent's unapplied draft.
